provenance: Actual installed G1 firmware, disposable local profile, no physical USB. Values are independently observed via TYPE/STRING and ordinary returned scalar/list values. Undecoded nonfinite host representations and rejected spellings are excluded from passing cases.

cases.name: cas-acceptance-reference-assign
cases.source: EXPORT CASASSIGN() BEGIN LOCAL r; CAS("purge(zztest)"); r:=CAS("zztest:=7"); RETURN {TYPE(r),STRING(r),CAS("zztest+2")}; END;

cases.name: cas-acceptance-reference-argument
cases.source: EXPORT CASARG() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2; RETURN CAS("a+1"); END;

cases.name: cas-acceptance-reference-function
cases.source: EXPORT CASFUNC() BEGIN CAS("zzfun(x):=x+1"); RETURN CAS("zzfun(4)"); END;

cases.name: cas-special-values-reference-infinitytype
cases.source: EXPORT CASINFTYPE() BEGIN LOCAL a:=CAS("1/0"); RETURN {TYPE(a),STRING(a)}; END;

cases.name: cas-special-values-reference-undeftype
cases.source: EXPORT CASUNDTYPE() BEGIN LOCAL a:=CAS("0/0"); RETURN {TYPE(a),STRING(a)}; END;

cases.name: cas-special-values-reference-eval
cases.source: EXPORT EVALTEST() BEGIN RETURN EVAL(7); END;

cases.name: cas-boundary-reference-bounds
cases.source: EXPORT CASBOUND() BEGIN LOCAL z:=CAS("-1/0"),p:=CAS("+infinity"),n:=CAS("-infinity"),u:=CAS("undef"); RETURN {TYPE(z),STRING(z),TYPE(p),STRING(p),TYPE(n),STRING(n),TYPE(u),STRING(u)}; END;

cases.name: cas-boundary-reference-exactlower
cases.source: EXPORT EXACTLOW() BEGIN LOCAL r:=exact(0.25); RETURN {TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-boundary-reference-emptycall
cases.source: EXPORT EMPTYCALL() BEGIN LOCAL r:={}; IFERR r:=CONCAT(r,{STRING(CAS("sin()"))}); THEN r:=CONCAT(r,{"caught"}); END; RETURN r; END;

cases.name: cas-boundary-reference-storedspecial
cases.source: EXPORT STORESPECIAL() BEGIN CAS("zzbound:=1/0"); RETURN {TYPE(CAS("zzbound")),STRING(CAS("zzbound")),STRING(CAS("1/0+2")),STRING(CAS("infinity>0"))}; END;

cases.name: cas-source-data-evalstring
cases.source: EXPORT EVALSTR() BEGIN LOCAL r:=EVAL("1+2"); RETURN {TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-source-data-evalcollection
cases.source: EXPORT EVALCOL() BEGIN LOCAL r:=EVAL({"2+3",CAS("zzdynamic+1")}); RETURN {TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-source-data-exactcollection
cases.source: EXPORT EXACTCOL() BEGIN LOCAL r:=exact({0.25,"1/3"}); RETURN {TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-assignment-argument-reference-assign
cases.source: EXPORT CASASG() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2,r; r:=CAS(a:=3); RETURN {a,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-assignment-argument-reference-store
cases.source: EXPORT CASSTORE() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2,r; r:=CAS(3▶a); RETURN {a,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-assignment-argument-reference-assignexpr
cases.source: EXPORT CASASGEX() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2,r; r:=CAS(a:=SIN(0)+5); RETURN {a,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-assignment-argument-reference-assignname
cases.source: EXPORT CASASGN() BEGIN LOCAL abc:=2,r; r:=CAS(abc:=3); RETURN {abc,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-assignment-argument-reference-nested
cases.source: EXPORT CASASGNEST() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2,r; r:=CAS(1+(a:=3)); RETURN {a,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-assignment-argument-reference-exactstrtype
cases.source: EXPORT EXACTSTYPE() BEGIN RETURN TYPE(exact("1/3")); END;

cases.name: cas-assignment-argument-reference-exactstrvalue
cases.source: EXPORT EXACTSVAL() BEGIN RETURN STRING(exact("1/3")); END;

cases.name: exact-string-reference-arithmetic
cases.source: EXPORT EXARITH() BEGIN LOCAL r:=exact("1+2"); RETURN {TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: exact-string-reference-decimal
cases.source: EXPORT EXDEC() BEGIN LOCAL r:=exact("0.25"); RETURN {TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: exact-string-reference-symbol
cases.source: EXPORT EXSYM() BEGIN LOCAL r:=exact("zzunknown"); RETURN {TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: exact-string-reference-nestedcas
cases.source: EXPORT CASASGNEST() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2,r; r:=CAS({a:=3,4}); RETURN {a,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: exact-string-reference-call
cases.source: EXPORT CASASGCALL() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2,r; r:=CAS(sin(a:=3)); RETURN {a,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-collection-reference-listfraction
cases.source: EXPORT CASLF() BEGIN LOCAL r:=CAS({1/2}); RETURN {TYPE(r),TYPE(r(1)),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-collection-reference-vectorassign
cases.source: EXPORT CASVA() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2,r; r:=CAS([a:=3,4]); RETURN {a,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-collection-reference-callside
cases.source: SIDE() BEGIN A:=A+1; RETURN 3; END; EXPORT CASSIDE() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r:=CAS(SIDE()); RETURN {A,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-collection-reference-stringassign
cases.source: EXPORT CASASTR() BEGIN LOCAL a:=2,r; r:=CAS(a:="1+2"); RETURN {a,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-collection-reference-exactescaped
cases.source: EXPORT EXESC() BEGIN LOCAL r:=exact("zzunicode+1"); RETURN STRING(r); END;

cases.name: cas-dynamic-arguments-reference-nativeexpr
cases.source: SIDE() BEGIN A:=A+1; RETURN 3; END; EXPORT CASDYNEX() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r:=CAS(SIDE()+1); RETURN {A,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-dynamic-arguments-reference-casdynamictext
cases.source: SIDE() BEGIN A:=A+1; RETURN "1/2"; END; EXPORT CASDYNTXT() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r:=CAS(SIDE()); RETURN {A,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;

cases.name: cas-dynamic-arguments-reference-listside
cases.source: SIDE() BEGIN A:=A+1; RETURN 3; END; EXPORT CASDYNLIST() BEGIN A:=0; LOCAL r:=CAS({SIDE()+1,1/2}); RETURN {A,TYPE(r),STRING(r)}; END;
